newsitem.title: SPAIN: Continente H1 net profit fell to 3.46 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Continente H1 net profit fell to 3.46 bln ptas.

text.p: Results for first half in billions of pesetas, unless stated:

NOTE- Spanish supermarket chain Centro Comerciales Continente said sales growth had been hampered by new government regulation on advertising and the continued weakness of consumption. The biggest spending items were hypermarkets less than three years old, logistics and advertising. The company said pre-tax profit was not comparable to 1995 as last year's data included extraordinary factors which boosted results by around one billion pesetas. Continente has invested 10.1 billion pesetas in the first half of the year opening three new hypermarkets in Badajoz, Torrelavega and Gijon. It has started work on centres in Burgos and Getafe which are due to open next year. In June, Continente bought 34 percent of a new joint venture with the Luis Pina distribution group to run its hypermarkets under franchise and with a Continente name.
